chapter.verse: Tu-in thuciamna a masapen nangawn in biakpiak ngeina paiziate leh leitung ah siangtho mun khat na nei lai buang hi.
A hang pen biakbuk a masa khat kilam a, tua sungah meivaktau, sabuai leh Ompihna anlum kikoih hi. Tua mun pen Siangtho Mun kici hi.
Inndei puanpi a nihna nungah Siangthopen Mun a kici biakbuk khat om hi.

Tua mun ah kham kizut paknamtui biakpiaktau leh a pang tung teng khempeuh kham tawh kituam thuciamna singkuang om a, tua sungah manna kikoihna kham beel khat, tehno a sel Aaron ciangkhut leh thuciam suangpekte om hi.
Tua ii a tungsan ah minphatna Cherub-te om a, tuate in mawhphelna tokhom liimsun uh hi. Tu tadihin hih thute a nensi dongin gen theih hilo hi.
Tu-a bangin nate a kikoihkholh khit ciangin biakbuk a masa sungah siampite lutin biakpiak vai teng sem uh hi.
Biakbuk a nihna sung ahihleh siampi lianpenpa bek kum khatin khatvei lut a, sisan keng hamtangin amahmah' ading leh theihloh mana mawhna a bawl mipihte' adingin biakpiakna luui hi.
Hih tungtawnin Kha Siangtho' hong lahtel thu in biakbuk masa a om laisiah siangtho munte sung lut nading lampi kihong nailo cih ahi hi.
Hih pen tu khanghun etsakna lim hi a, hih ngeina zui-a a kiluui biakpiak vante leh biakpiaknate in a bia mite ii a kitheihtawmna lungsim uh cingtaaksak theilo hi.
Tuate pen annek tuidawn vai leh kisiansuahna a nam tuamtuam vai hi bek a, paizia thak a kizat hun a tun masung cilesa pumpi' tunga a kisuan ngeina paiziate ahi hi.

Tu-in ahihleh hong tung khinsa a hoih thute a sem siampi lianpenpa khat bangin Khris hong kilang khin hi. Amah in khut tawh kibawl ahilo, hih piansak leitung pan ahilo, a lianzaw leh a cingtaakzaw biakbuk sung tawnin
keeltal leh bawngno sisan tawh ahilo, ama' sisan mahmah tawh siangtho munte ah khatvei tawh a kicing dingin lut a, tua tawh tawntung tatkhiatna hong ngahkhiatsak hi.
A hang pen biaknavai-a a sianglo mite' tunga a kitheh keeltal leh bawngtal sisan ahi zongin, bawngla kangvute ahi zongin, tuate in cilesa pumpi a siang ahih nadingin siansuah thei lai ahihleh

tawntung Kha tungtawnin Pasian' kiangah amahmah sitbaanglo-in a kiluui Khris ii sisan in a nungta Pasian' na i sep theih nadingin na-a kimanglo nasepnate pan eite' kitheihtawmna lungsim hong siansuah theizaw kan ding hilo ahi hiam?

Hih thu hangin thuciamna a masa lai-a mite, amau' palsatnate pan a tankhia dingin sihna thu khat piang khinzo ahih manin Khris pen kamciam kipiasa tawntung gamh, sapkhiat mite in a ngah theih nadingun a vaihawmsak, thuciamna thak kamkhapna palai ahi hi.
A hang pen sih vaikhakna thuciam vai ah thuciam a bawlpa ii sihna thu, a kip masak ding kisam hi.
Sih vaikhakna thuciam cih pen thuciam a bawlpa a nuntak laisiah a kizatna om lo a, sihna a om ciang bekin taksuak pan hi.
Tua thu hangin thuciamna a masa nangawn, sisan om lo-in taksuak theilo hi.

A hang pen Moses in mipi bup' tungah thukhun sunga thupiakte khempeuh a pulak lai-in tui kihel bawngno leh keeltal sisan sungah tuumul san leh puknah hiang diahin tua tawh thukhun laibu leh mipi bup sisan theh hi.
Tua ciangin, “Hih pen note' adinga Pasian' hong thupiak ahi thuciamna sisan hi,” ci hi.
Tua mah bangin biakbuk leh siampi nasepna-a kizang vanzat khempeuh zong tua sisan theh hi.
Tua hi a, thukhun nuai-ah na khempeuh phial sisan tawh a kisiansuah hi a, sisan luankhiatna lo tawh mawhmaina om theilo hi.
Tua hangin vantung omzia etteh limte pen hih biakpiakziate tawh siansuahloh a phamawh hi a, ahi zongin tua vantung thute mahmah pen biakpiakzia a hoihzaw a kisam uh ahi hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh Khris a lutna mun pen khut tawh kibawl siangtho munte-a taktak thute ii etsakna limte-hilo-in vantung mahmah hi a, tu-in Pasian' mai-ah eite' taangin a va kilaak ahi hi.
Tua pen kum simin siampi lianpen a semte amau' sisan ahilo tawh siangtho munte ah a lut dan nam hilo hi. Khris pen amahmah biakpiakna-in a kiluui kikkik kul lo hi.

Hi hileh leitung kilamkip huna kipan gim a thuak kikkik kul ding hi. Tu-in ahihleh mawhna a hemkhia dingin amahmah biakpiakna-in hong kiluui a, khanghunte a kicin ciangin a bucingin khatvei hong kilang khinzo hi.
Mihingte pen khatvei a si dingin leh tua nungah thukhenna a thuak dingin a kiseh ahi hi.
Tua mah bangin mi a tampite' mawhna teng a thuak dingin khatvei hong kiluui khin ahi Khris zong mawhna vai a gen ding ahilo, lawptakin amah a ngakte a honkhia dingin nihveina hong kilang ding hi.
